overrides.reason: Embed-only entry point: chrome profile fixed to embed, no ?url= loading, no autosave/recent/PWA/plugin/dev hooks, Canvas2D only, adds the createBlankDocument RPC handler. The host owns open/save/new.
Registers fonts only through FontFace (no injected style element) and only requests the OFL fonts bundled in assets/fonts; CDN and non-shipped catalog entries are never fetched.
Print styles are externalised: static rules in print.css, per-page @page rules in a constructed stylesheet, so no inline style element is created.
Does not advertise plugin-loader-v1 and hwpctrl-v1 (not bundled); adds blank-document-v1.
Removes the plugin.* RPC methods and adds createBlankDocument.

assetOverrides.reason: Markup without inline style attributes, relative init scripts and without icon assets.
Loading surface with its stylesheet externalised.
